meta.name: documentation-graph-curator
meta.description: Maintain project documentation and Obsidian-first knowledge graph using Markdown notes, wikilinks, ADRs, artifact indexes, Mermaid diagrams as visual layer, change logs, and graph hygiene. Use when syncing docs after code changes, creating a project vault skeleton, updating project memory, linking requirements to architecture and tasks, cleaning stale notes, or making sure agents can navigate the project without confusion.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 同步代码变更,维护项目文档与知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果代码变更后总需要手动同步项目文档
copy.tagline_en: Keep project docs and knowledge graph in sync after code changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to update project docs after code changes

howto.what: 整理并更新项目文档和 Obsidian 知识图谱:用 wiki 链接把需求、架构、任务等关联起来,更新变更日志,并清理过时或断开的笔记。产出更新后的笔记、图谱清理摘要、决策记录、变更日志条目和过时笔记清单。
howto.when: 当你在代码改动后需要同步文档、创建项目笔记库骨架、更新项目记忆,或做其他文档/图谱维护时,本技能会接管。

say.text: 我刚改了订单模块的代码,请同步更新项目文档和知识图谱。
say.note: 会更新笔记、维基链接和变更日志。

say.text: 帮我为这个项目搭建一个 Obsidian 笔记库骨架,包含 ADR 和索引。
say.note: 会生成项目笔记骨架和链接结构。

say.text: 清理文档里过时和断开的链接,并标注缺失的工件。
say.note: 会列出过时笔记和图谱清理摘要。

howto.what_en: Updates project docs and Obsidian knowledge graph by wikilinking requirements, architecture, tasks, and other related notes; refreshing change logs; and cleaning stale/broken notes. Produces updated notes, link hygiene summary, decision record, changelog entry, and stale-note list.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to sync docs after code changes, create a project vault skeleton, update project memory, or perform other documentation/graph maintenance.

say_en.text: I just changed the order module code, please sync the project docs and knowledge graph.
Set up an Obsidian vault skeleton for this project, including ADRs and indexes.
say_en.note: Generates note skeleton and link structure.

say_en.text: Clean up stale and broken links in the docs, and flag missing artifacts.
say_en.note: Lists stale notes and summarizes graph hygiene.
